dataset: Central Athens OpenStreetMap geometry for Politeia
projection: Local equirectangular: x=(lon-originLon)*pi/180*6378137*cos(originLat); z=(lat-originLat)*pi/180*6378137; metres; east +x, north +z. Building heights are above each building's own ground; relief is in terrain.json.
buildingModel: OpenStreetMap Simple 3D Buildings: building:part ways and relations with their own height, min_height, roof:shape/height/direction and colours. An outline at least half covered by its parts (or listed as the outline of a type=building relation) is drawn by its parts only. Courtyards are multipolygon inner rings. cap = triangle indices over points followed by each hole; roof.points y = metres above the building ground; wallTops = per-point wall height where a roof slopes.
limitations: Central district sample, not a complete or photorealistic copy of Athens.

OSM footprint locations are real source geometry. Heights are tagged (height), inferred from building:levels at 3 m per level, inherited by a part from its tagged building, or explicit 12/6/3 m placeholder defaults; heightSource records which.

Roofs are drawn as flat, skillion, gabled (also used for round, gambrel and saltbox), hipped (four-sided convex footprints; others gabled), pyramidal/cone or dome/onion. Other shapes, sloping roofs over courtyards, skillions without roof:direction and footprints a gable ridge crosses more than twice are drawn flat. Untagged roof heights default to 3 m (domes: the footprint radius).
Colours are the mapped building:colour and roof:colour values; untagged buildings use the renderer palette. No facade textures, windows, interiors or architectural detail beyond the mapped parts.
Road widths use tagged widths, 3 m per lane, or class-based placeholder defaults; bridges are flattened and tunnels excluded.

Building relations come from a second extract whose server reported an older database snapshot (see relationsSource); their ways and the main extract can differ where they were edited between the two snapshots.
Landmark polygon positions are a vertex mean, not a verified entrance or safe walking spawn.
The acquisition source reports an OSM database timestamp earlier than the retrieval date; this is recorded without altering it.
